$comment: Not a shadcn install target: nothing is ever added to this project from a registry. It exists so @tecton/eslint-config can find the Tailwind entry stylesheet and read the project's real theme, which is how it tells a Tecton token from a class that generates no CSS at all. The linter also prints a notice about aliases.ui not resolving to a directory: Tecton ships its components inside @tecton/react rather than in a components/ui folder, so there is no such directory, and @tecton/eslint-config names the component imports itself through componentImports. The notice is expected and the rules are active without it.
